title: Diverse Word Choices, Same Reference: Annotating Lexically-Rich Cross-Document Coreference
reasoning: The paper focuses on cross-document coreference resolution (CDCR) and lexical diversity in news coverage to detect media bias. While it uses some examples involving religious figures (e.g., Warren Jeffs) to demonstrate coreference annotation in news datasets, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethical reasoning as defined in the prompt.
